full_prompt_en: A square watercolor-and-ink editorial cartoon shows an elderly man crouching low on a paved city street beneath an enormous overloaded backpack. He faces right in profile. A red peaked cap shades his lined forehead, round glasses sit on a prominent nose, and his mouth pushes forward in a weary frown. He wears a dusty blue jacket and trousers, a narrow yellow scarf at the neck, and thick yellow-brown boots planted on uneven paving stones. Both hands grip a long wooden pole rising at the right, with a small axe-like metal head at the top. The bulky olive backpack almost equals the figure in size. Its large pockets, tied cords, small bottles, loose belongings, and a protruding long handle make a complicated silhouette behind his shoulders. At his feet are a purple tied sack, a clear jar with a small object inside, and a gray bundle with leaves or branches sticking out. Small green weeds grow between the pavement stones around them. Pale facades of city buildings recede on both sides, drawn with thin gray lines and a few narrow windows. The central background is almost empty, leaving the man and his possessions isolated in white paper space. The face and hands are exaggerated, with a long nose, deep creases, and large knuckles, yet the clothes and pack are carefully textured with small watercolor stains and crosshatched ink marks. Cool blue and gray dominate the figure and street, while the red cap, yellow scarf, and ocher boots offer sharp warm accents. Light is bright and diffuse, giving only mild shadow beneath boots and bundles. The composition balances the heavy leftward pack against the upright pole at right, turning the character's stooped pose and scattered belongings into a compact, humorous silhouette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩墨线时事漫画描绘一名老人背着一只巨大而塞满的背包，在铺地城市街上低低蹲着。他侧身朝右。红色有檐帽遮住布满纹路的额头，圆眼镜架在突出的鼻梁上，嘴向前撅成疲惫的皱眉。他穿尘蓝外套与裤子，脖子系窄黄围巾，厚重黄棕靴踩在不平的铺石上。双手握着右侧升起的长木杆，顶端有一枚小斧状金属头。笨重橄榄色背包几乎与人物一样大。大口袋、系绳、小瓶、松散物件和一根突出的长柄让双肩后的剪影复杂。脚边有一个系紧的紫色袋、一只装着小物件的透明罐和一包灰色包裹，里面伸出叶或细枝。周围铺石缝间生着小绿草。两侧浅色城市建筑立面往后退，用细灰线和几扇窄窗描成。中央背景近乎空白，让人和行李孤立在白纸空间里。脸与手带夸张感，有长鼻、深皱纹和大指节，但衣物与背包仍由小水彩色渍与交叉墨线仔细表现。冷蓝与灰主导人物和街道，红帽、黄围巾和赭黄靴形成锐利暖色点。光明亮漫射，只在靴和包裹下有温和阴影。构图用沉重向左的背包平衡右侧竖杆，把佝偻姿势与散落行李变成紧凑幽默剪影。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor-and-ink cartooning combines sharply observed, elastic contours with lightly washed color on a mostly white page. A compact central mass carries many small pockets of texture, while thin gray background lines recede quickly into open space. Cool blue-gray and olive are punctuated by small red and ocher accents. Enlarged curves and angular protrusions create a humorous asymmetry without losing balance. Fine hatch marks, dry paper grain, and transparent stains add tactile variety inside otherwise clear silhouettes. Diffuse light keeps shadows modest, so line weight and color contrast do most of the modeling. The arrangement feels busy at its center and airy at the edges, with a strong upright line countering a heavier irregular cluster.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩墨线漫画把观察细致而有弹性的轮廓与轻薄水洗颜色结合，底下大部留白。紧凑中央大块带许多小肌理区，细灰背景线很快退入空域。冷蓝灰和橄榄色由少量红与赭黄点缀。放大的曲线和棱角突起造成幽默不对称，却没有失衡。细排线、干纸颗粒与透明色渍在清楚剪影内增添可触变化。漫射光让阴影克制，因此线条力度和色彩对照承担大部分塑形。排列中心繁忙，边沿空阔，一道强竖线平衡较重的不规则色簇。
theme_en: An elderly man with an oversized pack and axe-like walking pole on a city street
theme_zh: 一名老人背着巨大的行囊，扶着斧形长杆走在城市街上
name: Michael de Adder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
